storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
Video Downloader for Dailymotion makes it easy to save videos from Dailymotion.com to your computer.

How it works: Go to any video page on Dailymotion, click the extension icon in your toolbar, and the extension automatically detects the video. It fetches all available quality options directly from Dailymotion's player API, shows them in a clean popup, and lets you download as a standard MP4 file.

It handles HLS streaming and quality detection automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized Dailymotion subfolder.

Key features:
- Automatic video detection from Dailymotion's player metadata API
- All available quality levels displayed with resolution and format info
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions (e.g. 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p, 240p)
- Right-click context menu for quick downloads
- Video info card with thumbnail, title, duration, and ID
- Dark-themed UI with sky blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Dailymotion.com and open any video
3. Click the extension icon in your toolbar
4. Select quality and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any video page on Dailymotion.com. Click the extension icon in your toolbar, wait for the scan to complete, then select your preferred quality and click Download.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all qualities available for each video — typically 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p, and 240p. The exact options depend on what the uploader provided. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a Dailymotion subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Make sure you are on a Dailymotion video page (the URL should contain /video/). Click Rescan in the popup after the page has fully loaded. If issues persist, refresh the page and try again.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored. No data is sent to third-party servers.

faq.question: Does this work with embedded Dailymotion videos?
faq.answer: The extension works on Dailymotion.com video pages. For embedded videos on other sites, navigate to the original Dailymotion video page first.
